b: Home / Google News / Google AI Overviews AI-Generated Images Have Returned For Some

Google seems to be bringing back the ability for Google Search to generate images on the fly within Google Search. Google initially announced this back in July of this year and then paused the test the next month after some controversy. Now, it seems to be coming back for some searchers.

Back in July, when Google announced this, Google said, "To help bring those unique ideas to life, we’re bringing image generation directly into AI Overviews in Search."
